title: Sumi Sudoku
tagline: Ink-brush Sudoku with a watercolor park to rest in.
description: Classic Sudoku with Japanese ink-brush styling. Take a break in a living watercolor park inspired by Maruyama Park in Kyoto: 12 painted plants, seasons that turn every 5 minutes, day and night every 12, and tap-to-glow plants with fireflies and info cards.
